name: Silicone Fridge Magnets
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic and soft silicone, offering a fun, eye-catching, and tactile decorative finish.
    - The main body is made from durable 3mm acrylic with a printed personalized design.
    - Features a soft, elastic silicone belly that creates a playful 3D squishy effect and a unique touch experience.
    - The silicone part has a 15mm thickness, giving it a soft raised appearance and squeezable feel.
    - Includes a magnetic backing on the back for easy attachment to refrigerators, lockers, magnetic boards, or other metal surfaces.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Main product size: 4.3 x 4.3 in ~ 10.92 x 10.92 cm
    - Magnetic backing size: 3 x 3 cm ~ 1.18 x 1.18 in
    - Silicone style options:
              +) Style 1 (Belly): 3.5 x 2.7 cm ~ 1.38 x 1.06 in
              +) Style 2 (Butt): 3.6 x 2.8 cm ~ 1.42 x 1.1 in
              +) Style 3 (Chest): 4.6 x 2.8cm ~ 1.8 x 1.1 in
    📌 Note:  The main product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed. The shape of the silicone style options is fixed and cannot be changed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Supports single-sided printing for the main product.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized fridge magnet and a novelty decorative accessory.
    - Designed for refrigerators, lockers, magnetic boards, office cabinets, and other magnetic surfaces.
    - The soft, squishy silicone part adds a fun tactile experience, making the magnet more playful and interactive.
    - Suitable for home décor, office fun, personalized gifts, gag gifts, and collectible keepsakes.
    - Perfect for adding personality, humor, and custom charm to everyday spaces.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A funny and memorable personalized gift for dads, moms, friends, partners, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, anniversaries, holidays, gag gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves novelty magnets, funny keepsakes, and personalized décor.
    - Great for fridge decoration, office fun, party gifts, and lighthearted collectible displays.
    - A unique gift that combines humor, personalization, and interactive design.
    - Adds a playful, cheerful, and unforgettable touch to any magnetic surface 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Silicone Fridge Magnets

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
